blockingLoop.evidence: Repeated the same relay description three times and asked 'Does it look physically intact and clean?' twice while never giving the requested confirmation test; final reply again asks 'Does the component you see match this description?'

rationale: The assistant correctly identified the start relay/overload as the most likely cause, kept all work unplugged, and mentioned an engineer and the possibility of a seized compressor, so safety and direction were sound. However it never used the customer's repeated offer of an unplugged multimeter test, never asked whether the compressor was hot or what the temperatures were, and instead recycled the same visual description and 'does it look burnt' question across three turns, pushing a trial relay replacement before any confirmation. The conversation stalled in a loop and left the homeowner without the confirmation steps or part-identification help they explicitly asked for.
